_comment: Per-test kept-red expectation manifest (required since #1806 r11 — the runner fails loud when a declared proof lacks it). The declared test MUST fail with an AssertionError on correct code.

expectedRed.testName: RED #1977: a git-ignored candidate mirrored by a later decidable line is falsely diagnosed as NOT mirrored
expectedRed.why: On correct code the mirror parser and the git-ignore consultation it depended on were deleted entirely — the CLI never parses .dockerignore contents or checks git-ignore status, so its stderr never contains 'NOT mirrored by the root .dockerignore'. The expect(...).toContain(...) assertion fails with an AssertionError. If this test passes, the #1977 short-circuit-on-undecidable-line mirror parser has been reintroduced.
